'''XT''' was the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of the [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] royalty and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] Hero [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]]. XT assisted Vane in piloting his [[Tempest Zero/Legends|Tempest Zero]] during the [[Battle of the Hexus system]], as well as other engagements against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
